metadata.notes: This report was generated based on analysis of go.mod dependencies and cross-referenced with known CVE databases. The Kubernetes repository uses relatively recent dependency versions with most critical vulnerabilities patched.

vulnerabilities.description: Applications and libraries which misuse ServerConfig.PublicKeyCallback in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh may be susceptible to an authorization bypass. The callback may be called with multiple keys, and the order cannot be used to infer which key was used for authentication.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes uses golang.org/x/crypto/ssh only in test/e2e/framework/ssh/ssh.go for E2E testing. Production binaries are NOT affected per kubernetes/kubernetes#129164.

vulnerabilities.description: SSH Agent servers do not validate the size of messages when processing new identity requests, which may cause the program to panic if the message is malformed due to an out of bounds read.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes does not implement SSH Agent server functionality.

vulnerabilities.description: SSH servers parsing GSSAPI authentication requests do not validate the number of mechanisms specified in the request, allowing an attacker to cause unbounded memory consumption.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes does not use GSSAPI SSH authentication.

vulnerabilities.description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset attack - An attacker can send HTTP/2 requests, cancel them, and send subsequent requests, causing the gRPC-Go server to launch more concurrent method handlers than the configured maximum stream limit, leading to denial of service.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Medium - Kubernetes API server uses gRPC for communication. The current version v1.72.2 includes the fix. Users should ensure grpc.MaxConcurrentStreams server option is configured.

vulnerabilities.description: The HTML tokenizer incorrectly interprets tags with unquoted attribute values that end with a solidus character (/) as self-closing, which can result in content following such tags being placed in the wrong scope during DOM construction, potentially enabling cross-site scripting attacks.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes does not perform HTML parsing in security-critical contexts.

vulnerabilities.description: The protojson.Unmarshal function can enter an infinite loop when unmarshaling certain forms of invalid JSON. This condition can occur when unmarshaling into a message which contains a google.protobuf.Any value, or when the UnmarshalOptions.DiscardUnknown option is set.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Medium - Kubernetes uses protobuf extensively for API communication. The current version v1.36.6 includes the fix.

vulnerabilities.description: An attacker could send a JWE containing compressed data that used large amounts of memory and CPU when decompressed by Decrypt or DecryptMulti, leading to denial of service.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes uses go-jose for OIDC token validation. The current version v2.6.3 includes memory limits for decompression.

vulnerabilities.description: In etcd before versions 3.3.23 and 3.4.10, it is possible to have an entry index greater than the number of entries in the ReadAll method in wal/wal.go. This could cause issues when WAL entries are being read during consensus.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes uses etcd client libraries. The current version v3.6.0-alpha.0 includes all security patches.

vulnerabilities.description: In etcd before versions 3.3.23 and 3.4.10, certain directory paths are created with insecure permissions (etcd data directory and the directory path when provided to automatically generate self-signed certificates for TLS connections with clients).
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Affects local etcd installations only. Kubernetes control plane etcd deployments should follow security best practices.

vulnerabilities.description: HTTP/2 CONTINUATION flood in net/http - An attacker may cause an HTTP/2 endpoint to read arbitrary amounts of header data by sending an excessive number of CONTINUATION frames.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes API server HTTP/2 handling. The current version v0.47.0 includes the fix.

vulnerabilities.description: In etcd before versions 3.3.23 and 3.4.10, the etcd gateway is a simple TCP proxy to allow for basic service discovery and access. However, it is possible to include the gateway address as an endpoint, creating a denial of service loop.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Affects etcd gateway deployments. Standard Kubernetes installations do not use etcd gateway.

vulnerabilities.description: etcd before versions 3.3.23 and 3.4.10 does not perform any password length validation, which allows for very short passwords, such as those with a length of one.
vulnerabilities.kubernetes_impact: Low - Kubernetes uses certificate-based etcd authentication, not password authentication.

high_risk_chains.notes: golang.org/x/crypto is widely used for SSH and TLS operations. Current version v0.45.0 is patched for all known critical vulnerabilities.
gRPC is used for API server communication. Current version v1.72.2 includes all HTTP/2 DoS protections.
etcd client uses gRPC for communication with etcd cluster. Ensure MaxConcurrentStreams is configured.
go-jose is used for JWT/JWE operations in OIDC authentication. Current version v2.6.3 includes DoS protections.

k8s.io/api.notes: Core API type definitions. No external network operations.

k8s.io/apimachinery.notes: API machinery utilities for serialization/deserialization. Uses protobuf internally.

k8s.io/client-go.notes: Kubernetes client library. Handles credential caching and network operations. Review credential handling in production deployments.

k8s.io/apiserver.notes: API server library. Contains authentication and authorization logic. Critical for cluster security.

k8s.io/component-base.notes: Shared component utilities including configuration and feature gates.

short_term_actions.action: Verify grpc.MaxConcurrentStreams is configured for all gRPC servers
short_term_actions.rationale: Defense in depth against HTTP/2 Rapid Reset attacks even though the vulnerability is patched

short_term_actions.action: Review SSH key callback implementations in test infrastructure
short_term_actions.rationale: Ensure test code does not accidentally misuse PublicKeyCallback patterns

long_term_actions.rationale: Continuous monitoring for new CVEs affecting dependencies
Ensure production deployments follow security best practices for etcd

audit_notes.methodology: Dependency vulnerabilities were identified through analysis of go.mod, cross-referencing with NVD, GitHub Security Advisories, and the Go Vulnerability Database.
limitations: This analysis is based on declared dependencies in go.mod; runtime or conditional dependencies may not be fully captured.
Vulnerability impact assessment assumes standard Kubernetes deployment configurations.
Some historical vulnerabilities are included for audit trail completeness even though they are patched in current versions.
audit_notes.kubernetes_security_response: The Kubernetes Security Response Committee can be contacted at security@kubernetes.io for coordinated vulnerability disclosure.
audit_notes.existing_tooling_integration: The repository includes hack/verify-govulncheck.sh which uses govulncheck for ongoing vulnerability monitoring.
